units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 44a:9">Bekh. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אבל מ׳ לא</he> but mere defective eye-sight does not disqualify (opp. perfect blindness).

<cite ref="Bekhorot 44a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ מדק</he> the disqualification from defective eye-sight is derived from <cite ref="D00985"><he>דַּק</he></cite> (<cite ref="Leviticus 21:20">Lev. XXI, 20</cite>).
